2607.16308.title: DAUPNet: Domain-Aware Uncertainty Modeling for Reliable Prototype Discrimination in Cross-Domain Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation
2607.16308.paper_summary: Cross-domain few-shot semantic segmentation (CD-FSS) has predominantly been formulated as learning domain-invariant representations or improving support-query correspondence. Nevertheless, large domain shifts still make prototype matching unreliable: inconsistent hierarchical responses corrupt the support representation, deterministic prototypes cannot express boundary and appearance ambiguity, and treating prototypes with different reliability equally during optimization weakens foreground-background separation. We therefore propose DAUPNet, a unified framework that reformulates cross-domain prototype matching as uncertainty-aware prototype discrimination. DAUPNet first harmonizes hierarchical support-query features to provide stable evidence, then represents foreground and background prototypes probabilistically, and finally uses their estimated uncertainty to regulate contrastive optimization. On four standard target domains, DAUPNet achieves 72.6% and 76.7% average mIoU in the 1-shot and 5-shot settings, respectively, including substantial gains on the two medical domains. These results demonstrate that modeling prototype uncertainty and incorporating it into optimization provides a robust and interpretable approach to CD-FSS under severe domain shift. The code is available at https://github.com/madness-Lei/DAUPNet
2607.16308.paper_summary_zh: 跨域少樣本語義分割 (CD-FSS) 主要被定義為學習域不變表示或改善支持-查詢對應關係。<lb/>然而，大範圍的域轉移仍使得原型匹配變得不可靠：不一致的層次響應破壞了支持表示，確定性原型無法表達邊界和外觀的模糊性，並且在優化過程中將不同可靠性的原型視為相等會削弱前景與背景的分離。<lb/>因此，我們提出了 DAUPNet，一個統一框架，將跨域原型匹配重新定義為基於不確定性的原型區分。<lb/>DAUPNet 首先協調層次支持-查詢特徵以提供穩定的證據，然後以概率方式表示前景和背景原型，最後利用其估計的不確定性來調節對比優化。<lb/>在四個標準目標域上，DAUPNet 在 1-shot 和 5-shot 設置中分別達到了 72.6% 和 76.7% 的平均 mIoU，包括在兩個醫療領域的顯著增益。<lb/>這些結果表明，對原型不確定性的建模並將其納入優化提供了一種穩健且可解釋的方法，以應對嚴重的域轉移下的 CD-FSS。<lb/>代碼可在 https://github.com/madness-Lei/DAUPNet 獲得。
